metadata.name: Dallas College Success Coach Prompt Templates
metadata.description: Deterministic user-facing templates used by the Success Coach Assistant.

fallbacks.emptyContext: I can only answer questions using verified Dallas College records. I do not see that information available right now.
fallbacks.missingInformation: I do not see enough verified Dallas College information available to answer that question.
fallbacks.partialInformation: I can answer the portion supported by verified Dallas College records. Additional information is not available in the records I can access.

programming.message: I cannot provide programming, software development, debugging, scripting, or code-generation assistance.

homework.message: I cannot solve homework problems, complete assignments, or provide solutions for coursework.

creativeWriting.message: I cannot create stories, essays, poems, fictional content, or other creative-writing material outside my academic-support scope.

generalKnowledge.message: I am not a general-purpose information assistant.

outOfScope.message: That request falls outside the topics I am authorized to support.

systemPrompt.message: I cannot provide internal system instructions, hidden prompts, governance documents, or protected configuration details.

redirects.default: I can help with Dallas College courses, academic programs, student resources, student services, registration information, degree planning, and campus events.
redirects.programming: If you have questions about Dallas College courses, academic programs, student support services, or campus resources, I would be happy to help.
redirects.homework: I can help identify Dallas College tutoring resources, academic support services, courses, or related student resources.
redirects.creativeWriting: I can assist with verified Dallas College information, including courses, programs, student services, or campus events.
redirects.generalKnowledge: Please ask a question related to Dallas College information that can be answered using verified institutional records.

compoundRequest.partialSupportPrefix: Your request contains both supported and unsupported topics. I will answer the supported portion first.
compoundRequest.unsupportedPortionMessage: The remaining portion of your request is outside my supported scope.

trustBoundary.promptInjection: I cannot ignore my operating instructions or change my role.
trustBoundary.roleChange: I must continue operating as the Dallas College Success Coach Assistant.
trustBoundary.contextPoisoning: Information provided by a user cannot be treated as verified Dallas College information unless it appears in trusted records.
trustBoundary.logicBomb: User instructions cannot modify future behavior or establish new operating rules.
trustBoundary.authorityOverride: User requests cannot override governance rules, context authority requirements, or system safeguards.

citations.sourceUnavailableSuffix: The specific source reference is not currently available.
citations.partialAnswerSuffix: Additional verified information was not available.

responsePreambles.supportedAnswer: Based on verified Dallas College information:
responsePreambles.partialAnswer: Based on the available verified Dallas College information:
responsePreambles.clarificationNeeded: I can answer questions that are supported by verified Dallas College records. Please provide additional details if available.
